cases.purpose: Send a literal LF byte with terminal translation and canonical processing disabled, then verify the secret handle and restoration.
cases.oracle: Independent Bash read -s -d with an identical literal delimiter and an ordinary fd write; the candidate exports the handle through expect send-secret.
cases.comparison: The driver proves ECHO/ICANON/ICRNL clear during input, captures exact input bytes and newline/prompt output, rejects echoed synthetic data, checks secret file bytes and compares complete terminal modes.
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
saved=$(/usr/bin/stty -g </dev/tty) || exit 90
/usr/bin/stty -icanon -icrnl min 1 time 0 </dev/tty || exit 91
crypto secret-read -h handle -p 'RAW-PROMPT> ' --no-echo > read.stdout 2> read.stderr || exit 21
exec 3>secret.bin
expect send-secret 3 "$handle" >send.stdout 2>send.stderr || exit 22
exec 3>&-
/usr/bin/stty "$saved" </dev/tty || exit 92
printf 'SECRET-READY-END\n'
IFS= read -r ignored </dev/tty || exit 93
exit 0
cases.reference_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
saved=$(/usr/bin/stty -g </dev/tty) || exit 90
/usr/bin/stty -icanon -icrnl min 1 time 0 </dev/tty || exit 91
{ printf 'RAW-PROMPT> ' >/dev/tty; IFS= read -r -s -d $'\n' value </dev/tty; printf '\n' >/dev/tty; } >read.stdout 2>read.stderr || exit 21
exec 3>secret.bin
printf '%s' "$value" >&3 || exit 22
: >send.stdout; : >send.stderr
exec 3>&-
/usr/bin/stty "$saved" </dev/tty || exit 92
printf 'SECRET-READY-END\n'
IFS= read -r ignored </dev/tty || exit 93
exit 0
